title: Flying Lotus attends the tridactyl unveiling presentation
summary: Flying Lotus tells of Flying Lotus attends the tridactyl unveiling presentation, about 2020s at Los Angeles area (near Flying Lotus's home), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Angeles area (near Flying Lotus's home)

tellings.quote: Um well, they didn't have them there. There was a presentation like saying that they are, you know, they were showing the photos and the the X-rays and all that stuff.

plain: A well-known hip hop musician who goes by Flying Lotus says that in the 2020s he went to a presentation near his home in the Los Angeles area about small three-fingered bodies said to be non-human, linked to a presenter named Jaime Maussan. He says the bodies themselves were not there, but the presenters showed photos and X-rays meant to show they were real.
